# omadafusion Provider

Manage a TP-Link Omada controller through its web API (v2), including the controller built into Omada Fusion gateways. Authenticates with a local controller account rather than an Open API client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    omadafusion = {
      source = "inkstom/omadafusion"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials come from the environment:
#   export OMADA_URL=https://192.168.0.1
#   export OMADA_USERNAME=terraform
#   export OMADA_PASSWORD=...
provider "omadafusion" {
  site     = "Default"
  insecure = true # integrated controllers use a self-signed certificate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Integrated controllers use a self-signed certificate by default. Env: `OMADA_INSECURE`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for `username`. Env: `OMADA_PASSWORD`.
- `site` (String) Default site name or ID for resources that do not set `site`. Env: `OMADA_SITE`.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout per request. Defaults to 60.
- `url` (String) Controller base URL, e.g. `https://192.168.0.1`. Env: `OMADA_URL`.
- `username` (String) Local controller account. Use a dedicated, site-limited admin. Env: `OMADA_USERNAME`.
